supersedes: S35 post-funding exhaustion; this is a new dual-regime hypothesis, not a parameter rescue
objective: After an unusually crowded funding event, let three completed bars classify a causal FADE, CONTINUATION or NO_TRADE state; enter only after a later confirmed retest.

sources: 5m perpetual OHLCV, quote volume, trade count and taker-buy quote volume
data.access: anonymous checksum-verified Binance public archives only; no account, API key, private file or application
data.missing_policy: no interpolation, resampling or forward-fill; a gap invalidates only the affected feature, setup or open position
data.funding_timestamp: ceil raw calc_time to the first 5m boundary at or after it; never floor
data.history: all ranks and percentiles use exactly the previous 180 realized funding events of the same symbol and exclude the classified event
data.order_flow_proxy: bar delta = (2 * taker_buy_quote_volume - quote_volume) / quote_volume; this is a public trade-flow proxy, not order-book CVD

event_definition.time: T is the causal funding timestamp; B0 is the bar ending at T; all event features stop at B0
event_definition.mandatory_funding: abs(funding[T]) >= max(0.0001, trailing Q75 of abs funding over the previous 180 events)
event_definition.quorum: at least 3 of 5 distinct criteria; criteria do not substitute for later regime confirmation
criteria: premium: mark/index - 1 at B0 has the funding sign and abs premium >= max(0.0002, trailing Q75 abs pre-event premium)
60m extension: completed 60m return through B0 has the funding sign and abs return >= trailing Q65
4h extension: completed 4h return through B0 has the funding sign and abs return >= trailing Q60
Bollinger extension: funding_sign * (B0 close - SMA20) / population_STD20 >= 1.50, using only completed 5m closes
volume expansion: mean quote volume of the final 12 completed 5m bars >= 1.50 * median quote volume of the previous 2016 completed 5m bars
event_definition.deduplication: one immutable setup id per symbol and funding timestamp

observation.bars: B1, B2 and B3 open at T, T+5m and T+10m; classification occurs only at T+15m after B3 closes
observation.atr: Wilder ATR(14) fixed from B0 and used for every classification and retest threshold
observation.pre_ranges: FADE structure uses the final 4 completed pre-T bars; CONTINUATION breakout uses the final 6
observation.delta: aggregate B1-B3 delta is sum(2*taker_buy_quote_volume - quote_volume) / sum(quote_volume)
observation.ambiguity: if data allow both states or neither state, classify NO_TRADE

mandatory: at least one B1-B3 close breaks the opposite edge of the pre-4-bar range by at least 0.05 ATR
B3 close remains at least 0.05 ATR beyond that broken level
abs signed B3 premium <= 0.50 * abs B0 premium
abs B3 premium <= abs B2 premium
soft_criteria: one opposite-sign B1-B3 displacement body >= 0.50 ATR and closes in the final 25% of its range
funding_sign * aggregate_delta <= -0.10 and at least two B1-B3 bar deltas have the opposite sign
funding_sign * (B3 close / B0 close - 1) is negative with absolute price change >= 0.50 ATR

mandatory: the mandatory FADE structure conditions are not all satisfied
at least one B1-B3 close breaks the funding-side edge of the pre-6-bar range by at least 0.05 ATR
B3 close remains at least 0.05 ATR beyond that breakout level
funding_sign * B3 premium >= 0.75 * abs B0 premium
at least two B1-B3 signed premiums retain >= 0.50 * abs B0 premium
soft_criteria: funding_sign * (B3 close / B0 close - 1) is positive with absolute price change >= 0.50 ATR
funding_sign * aggregate_delta >= 0.10 and at least two B1-B3 bar deltas have the funding sign
completed 4h return retains the funding sign and funding_sign * Bollinger z-score at B3 >= 1.00

retest_and_entry.window: inspect at most the next 3 fully completed 5m bars after classification
retest_and_entry.touch: the bar range intersects breakout level +/- 0.10 ATR
retest_and_entry.acceptance: bar closes at least 0.05 ATR on the trade side of the level and its body has the trade direction
retest_and_entry.premium: FADE requires abs premium <= 0.75 * abs B0 premium; CONTINUATION requires funding_sign * premium >= 0.50 * abs B0 premium
retest_and_entry.entry: market at the next 5m open after the first qualifying completed retest bar
expiry: a retest bar closes 0.15 ATR beyond the level on the invalid side
before a retest, price closes more than 1.50 ATR away from the level
retest_and_entry.collision: one global position; sort by classification soft-count, event quorum count, funding/threshold ratio, then SUI, DOGE, XRP, SOL, ETH

initial_stop_and_sizing.structural_stop: LONG below the lowest low from B1 through the retest, SHORT above the highest high, plus an adverse buffer max(0.15 ATR, 2 ticks)
initial_stop_and_sizing.minimum_distance: max(0.60 ATR, 0.0060 * entry price, 3 ticks); widen only to this predefined minimum
initial_stop_and_sizing.maximum_distance: min(2.50 ATR, 0.0300 * entry price); veto if structural distance exceeds it or maximum < minimum
initial_stop_and_sizing.risk: min(0.50 USD, 0.20% of min(current equity, 250 USD)), inclusive of stress stop friction
initial_stop_and_sizing.liquidity: notional <= 0.10% of the minimum quote volume of the 12 completed bars before entry
initial_stop_and_sizing.quantization: quantity rounds down to frozen MARKET_LOT_SIZE; prices round adversely to tick; minimum historical notional is conservatively 20 USD; never increase risk to meet it

position_management.profit_unit: R is the initial stress-inclusive dollar risk and price barrier distance recorded at entry
position_management.partial_if_executable: at +1R close 50% rounded down to quantity step only if both child orders are at least 20 USD notional; otherwise do not split
position_management.breakeven: after a completed bar first reaches +1R, activate from the next bar a stop on all remaining quantity intended to leave +2 bps net after stress round-trip costs
position_management.trailing: after a completed bar first reaches +1.5R, activate next bar; LONG uses the tighter valid improvement of cost-BE, highest completed close minus 1.50 ATR, and the lowest low of the last 3 completed bars minus 0.15 ATR; SHORT is symmetric
position_management.stagnation_exit: after 60 minutes, exit next open only if MFE <0.50R and marked net PnL is non-positive
position_management.time_exit: 120 minutes if +1R was never reached; otherwise 180 minutes
position_management.stop_rule: stop never loosens; gaps fill at worse of bar open or stop plus slippage; if stop and target are both possible in one bar, stop occurs first
position_management.funding: exclude the pre-entry settlement; book every later realized funding while the position is open with the correct side

portfolio_risk.drawdown_kill: 4.00% mark-to-market from high-water mark, permanent RISK_FAIL for the replay window
prohibitions: no leverage or risk increase after results

windows.genuine_oos: first complete UTC day after protocol and implementation hashes are frozen

edge_gate: retrospective evaluation stress: >=60 trades, PF >=1.10, net >0
validation plus evaluation: net expectancy >=0.05R and lower 95% UTC-week block-bootstrap mean trade PnL >0
stress maximum drawdown <=4% with no risk violation
FADE and CONTINUATION each have >=25 total trades, PF >=1.00 and positive net
at least 3 symbols each have >=10 validation-plus-evaluation trades and positive stress net
no symbol supplies >50% of validation-plus-evaluation trades or positive gross PnL
LONG and SHORT each supply >=20% of all trades

income_target_gate.target: 25 USD average net per calendar day from 250 USD initial capital
income_target_gate.calculation: stress net divided by every calendar day including zero-trade days
income_target_gate.required: validation and retrospective evaluation each have mean >=25 USD/day and lower 95% UTC-week block-bootstrap mean daily PnL >=25 USD/day
report: diagnostic capital required at observed return
income_target_gate.independence: EDGE_PASS/FAIL and INCOME_TARGET_PASS/FAIL are separate; never resize after seeing results

ai: shadow-only APPROVE/VETO label after deterministic qualification; no execution effect until >=100 prospective fixed-model and fixed-prompt decisions prove positive incremental stress expectancy versus the identical baseline
promotion: historical pass permits paper-forward only; live remains disabled until >=40 prospective trades over >=6 months pass the same stress and drawdown gates
reality_boundary: 25 USD from 250 USD is 10% per day and 50R per day at the frozen 0.50 USD risk. No result is a guarantee and leverage may not be used to manufacture the income gate.
